Package com.kerosene.kfe.pricing.adapters.out.bitcoin

Class KfeNetworkFeeEstimateService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.pricing.adapters.out.bitcoin.KfeNetworkFeeEstimateService
@Service public class KfeNetworkFeeEstimateService extends Object
Estimates on-chain fees, prices payments, and issues signed short-lived fee quotes.
